_comment: Accuracy ratchet for the owned advisory-store engine (ownadvisory.Source) over detection-golden-v1. Floors may only RISE (a ratchet): the gate fails if a measured precision/recall drops below a floor, catching a matcher or feed regression. Baseline is 1.0/1.0 on this curated corpus (patched versions must never be flagged; known-vulnerable versions must always be flagged). To ADD corpus cases that a current matcher cannot yet satisfy, either fix the matcher or file the gap; do not lower a floor.
